```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidysynth)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)


# ============================================
# 1. SDUD DATA
# ============================================
process_file <- function(file) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(State != "XX") %>%
    mutate(
      qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4,
      across(c(`Number of Prescriptions`, `Total Amount Reimbursed`, `Units Reimbursed`), as.numeric)
    ) %>%
    group_by(State, qtime, Year, Quarter, `Utilization Type`) %>%
    summarise(
      rx = sum(`Number of Prescriptions`, na.rm = TRUE),
      reimbursed = sum(`Total Amount Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      units = sum(`Units Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Generate file list
sdud_files <- paste0("SDUD/StateDrugUtilizationData-", 2015:2025, ".csv")
panel_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(sdud_files, process_file))

# Merge SDUD data into panel 
panel <- panel_raw %>%
  group_by(State, qtime, Year, Quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    total_rx = sum(rx, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_reimbursed = sum(reimbursed, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_units = sum(units, na.rm = TRUE),
    ffsu_rx = sum(rx[`Utilization Type` == "FFSU"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mcou_rx = sum(rx[`Utilization Type` == "MCOU"], na.rm = TRUE),
    ffsu_share = ffsu_rx / total_rx,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 2. ENROLLMENT DATA
# ============================================
enrollment <- read_csv("pi-dataset-march-2026release.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

enrollment_q <- enrollment %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(`Reporting Period` %/% 100),
    Month = as.integer(`Reporting Period` %% 100),
    Quarter = ceiling(Month / 3),
    qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4
  ) %>%
  group_by(State = `State Abbreviation`, qtime) %>%
  summarise(
    enrollment = mean(`Total Medicaid and CHIP Enrollment`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge enrollment into panel 
panel <- panel %>%
  left_join(enrollment_q, by = c("State", "qtime")) %>%
  mutate(
    rx_per_enrollee = total_rx / enrollment,
    reimbursed_per_enrollee = total_reimbursed / enrollment
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 3. SYNTHETIC CONTROL — California Carve-Out
# ============================================
treatment_time <- 2022.0

contaminated <- c("OH", "NY", "WV", "TN", "MO", "ND", "WI")

panel_ca <- panel %>%
  filter(!State %in% contaminated, State != "XX", State != "PR") %>%
  mutate(ffsu_share = ifelse(is.finite(ffsu_share), ffsu_share, 0))

n_periods <- n_distinct(panel_ca$qtime)
panel_ca <- panel_ca %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  filter(n() == n_periods) %>%
  ungroup()

sc_ca <- panel_ca %>%
  synthetic_control(
    outcome = ffsu_share,
    unit = State,
    time = qtime,
    i_unit = "CA",
    i_time = treatment_time,
    generate_placebos = TRUE
  ) %>%
  generate_predictor(
    time_window = c(2015, treatment_time - 0.25),
    ffsu_share = mean(ffsu_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    rx_per_enrollee = mean(rx_per_enrollee, na.rm = TRUE),
    cost_per_rx = mean(total_reimbursed / total_rx, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  generate_weights(optimization_window = c(2015, treatment_time - 0.25)) %>%
  generate_control()

sc_ca %>% plot_trends()
sc_ca %>% plot_differences()
sc_ca %>% plot_placebos()
sc_ca %>% plot_mspe_ratio()
sc_ca %>% grab_unit_weights() %>% arrange(desc(weight))

# SC for Cost per Rx
panel_ca_cost <- panel %>%
  filter(!State %in% contaminated, State != "XX", State != "PR") %>%
  mutate(
    cost_per_rx = total_reimbursed / total_rx,
    ffsu_share = ifelse(is.finite(ffsu_share), ffsu_share, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(cost_per_rx))

n_periods_cost <- n_distinct(panel_ca_cost$qtime)
panel_ca_cost <- panel_ca_cost %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  filter(n() == n_periods_cost) %>%
  ungroup()

sc_ca_cost <- panel_ca_cost %>%
  synthetic_control(
    outcome = cost_per_rx,
    unit = State,
    time = qtime,
    i_unit = "CA",
    i_time = treatment_time,
    generate_placebos = TRUE
  ) %>%
  generate_predictor(
    time_window = c(2015, treatment_time - 0.25),
    cost_per_rx = mean(cost_per_rx, na.rm = TRUE),
    rx_per_enrollee = mean(total_rx / enrollment, na.rm = TRUE),
    ffsu_share = mean(ffsu_share, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  generate_weights(optimization_window = c(2015, treatment_time - 0.25)) %>%
  generate_control()

sc_ca_cost %>% plot_trends()
sc_ca_cost %>% plot_differences()
sc_ca_cost %>% plot_placebos()
sc_ca_cost %>% plot_mspe_ratio()
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 4. DIFFERENCE-IN-DIFFERENCES — Robustness
# ============================================
library(fixest)



panel_did_ca <- panel %>%
  filter(!State %in% contaminated, State != "XX", State != "PR") %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    ffsu_share = ifelse(is.finite(ffsu_share), ffsu_share, 0),
    cost_per_rx = total_reimbursed / total_rx,
    periods_to_treat = as.integer(round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cost_per_rx), is.finite(cost_per_rx))

# DiD regressions
did_ffsu <- feols(ffsu_share ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = panel_did_ca, vcov = ~State)
did_cost <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = panel_did_ca, vcov = ~State)
summary(did_ffsu)
summary(did_cost)

# Event studies
es_ffsu <- feols(ffsu_share ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                 data = panel_did_ca, vcov = ~State)
es_cost <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                 data = panel_did_ca, vcov = ~State)

iplot(es_ffsu, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: FFSU Share (California)")
iplot(es_cost, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: Cost per Rx (California)")

```

```{r}
did_units <- feols(units_per_rx ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 7. STAGGERED DiD — WV + CA + NY CARVE-OUTS

panel_stag <- panel %>%
  filter(State != "XX", State != "PR",
         !State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "OH")) %>%
  mutate(
    treat_time = case_when(
      State == "WV" ~ 2017.5,
      State == "CA" ~ 2022.0,
      State == "NY" ~ 2023.25,
      TRUE ~ Inf
    ),
    cost_per_rx = total_reimbursed / total_rx,
    ffsu_share = ifelse(is.finite(ffsu_share), ffsu_share, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(cost_per_rx))

# Staggered event studies
es_stag_ffsu <- feols(ffsu_share ~ sunab(treat_time, qtime) | State + qtime,
                      data = panel_stag, vcov = ~State)

      main = "Staggered Event Study: FFSU Share (WV + CA + NY)")

                      data = panel_stag, vcov = ~State)
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 8. PART D PLACEBO TEST — CALIFORNIA
# ============================================

partd_files <- list.files("Medicare_Part_D_Prescribers_Geography_Drug",
                          pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

process_partd <- function(file) {
  year <- as.numeric(gsub(".*DY(\\d{2}).*", "\\1", basename(file))) + 2000
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(Prscrbr_Geo_Lvl == "State") %>%
    group_by(State = Prscrbr_Geo_Cd) %>%
    summarise(
      partd_claims = sum(Tot_Clms, na.rm = TRUE),
      partd_cost = sum(Tot_Drug_Cst, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Year = year)
}

partd_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(partd_files, process_partd))

fips_to_state <- data.frame(
  fips = sprintf("%02d", c(1:2,4:6,8:13,15:42,44:51,53:56)),
  State = c("AL","AK","AZ","AR","CA","CO","CT","DE","DC","FL",
            "GA","HI","ID","IL","IN","IA","KS","KY","LA","ME",
            "MD","MA","MI","MN","MS","MO","MT","NE","NV","NH",
            "NJ","NM","NY","NC","ND","OH","OK","OR","PA","RI",
            "SC","SD","TN","TX","UT","VT","VA","WA","WV","WI","WY")
)

partd_raw <- partd_raw %>%
  mutate(State = sprintf("%02d", as.numeric(State)))

partd_raw <- partd_raw %>%
  left_join(fips_to_state, by = c("State" = "fips")) %>%
  select(-State) %>%
  rename(State = State.y)

partd_panel <- partd_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(State)) %>%
  mutate(
    cost_per_claim = partd_cost / partd_claims,
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(Year >= 2022),
    periods_to_treat = Year - 2022
  ) %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WV", "WI", "ND", "OH", "NY", "XX", "PR"))

did_partd <- feols(cost_per_claim ~ treated:post | State + Year, data = partd_panel)
summary(did_partd)

es_partd <- feols(cost_per_claim ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + Year,
                  data = partd_panel)
iplot(es_partd, xlab = "Years relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Placebo: Part D Cost per Claim (California)")

```

```{r}
# 9. SUMMARY RESULTS TABLE
# ============================================

results <- data.frame(
  State = c("CA", "CA", "CA", "CA",
            "NY", "NY", "NY", "NY",
            "WV", "WV", "WV", "WV",
            "CA (Part D)"),
  Outcome = c("Cost per Rx", "Rx per Enrollee", "Reimbursement per Enrollee", "Units per Rx",
              "Cost per Rx", "Rx per Enrollee", "Reimbursement per Enrollee", "Units per Rx",
              "Cost per Rx", "Rx per Enrollee", "Reimbursement per Enrollee", "Units per Rx",
              "Cost per Claim"),
  Estimate = c(coef(did_cost), coef(did_rx), coef(did_reimb), coef(did_units),
               coef(did_ny_cost), coef(did_ny_rx), coef(did_ny_reimb), coef(did_ny_units),
               coef(did_wv_cost), coef(did_wv_rx), coef(did_wv_reimb), coef(did_wv_units),
               coef(did_partd)),
  SE = c(se(did_cost), se(did_rx), se(did_reimb), se(did_units),
         se(did_ny_cost), se(did_ny_rx), se(did_ny_reimb), se(did_ny_units),
         se(did_wv_cost), se(did_wv_rx), se(did_wv_reimb), se(did_wv_units),
         se(did_partd)),
  P_value = c(pvalue(did_cost), pvalue(did_rx), pvalue(did_reimb), pvalue(did_units),
              pvalue(did_ny_cost), pvalue(did_ny_rx), pvalue(did_ny_reimb), pvalue(did_ny_units),
              pvalue(did_wv_cost), pvalue(did_wv_rx), pvalue(did_wv_reimb), pvalue(did_wv_units),
              pvalue(did_partd))
)

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = round(Estimate, 2),
    SE = round(SE, 2),
    P_value = round(P_value, 4),
    Sig = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      P_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

print(results, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 10. NADAC SPREAD ANALYSIS — PBM TRANSPARENCY
# ============================================

# Load all NADAC files, get quarterly average NADAC per NDC
process_nadac <- function(file) {
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    mutate(
      eff_date = as.Date(effective_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
      Year = as.integer(format(eff_date, "%Y")),
      Quarter = ceiling(as.integer(format(eff_date, "%m")) / 3),
      qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4,
      NDC = sprintf("%011.0f", as.numeric(ndc))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(qtime)) %>%
    group_by(NDC, qtime, classification_for_rate_setting) %>%
    summarise(
      nadac_per_unit = mean(nadac_per_unit, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

nadac_files <- paste0("NADAC/nadac-national-average-drug-acquisition-cost-",
                      2015:2025, ".csv")
nadac_all <- bind_rows(lapply(nadac_files, process_nadac))

# Load SDUD at NDC level — process one year at a time to save memory
process_ndc <- function(file) {
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(State != "XX") %>%
    mutate(
      qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4,
      NDC = sprintf("%011.0f", as.numeric(NDC)),
      `Units Reimbursed` = as.numeric(`Units Reimbursed`),
      `Total Amount Reimbursed` = as.numeric(`Total Amount Reimbursed`),
      `Number of Prescriptions` = as.numeric(`Number of Prescriptions`)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Units Reimbursed`), `Units Reimbursed` > 0) %>%
    group_by(State, NDC, qtime) %>%
    summarise(
      units = sum(`Units Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      reimbursed = sum(`Total Amount Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      rx = sum(`Number of Prescriptions`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

sdud_files <- paste0("SDUD/StateDrugUtilizationData-", 2015:2025, ".csv")
ndc_panel <- bind_rows(lapply(sdud_files, process_ndc))

# Join SDUD to NADAC by NDC and quarter
ndc_spread <- ndc_panel %>%
  inner_join(nadac_all, by = c("NDC", "qtime")) %>%
  mutate(
    reimbursed_per_unit = reimbursed / units,
    spread = reimbursed_per_unit - nadac_per_unit,
    spread_pct = spread / nadac_per_unit * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(spread_pct), abs(spread_pct) < 1000)

# --- CROSS-SECTIONAL: CA vs managed care states ---

# Excluding WV from visualizations — WV's July 2017 carve-out transition
# caused a temporary reimbursement crash below NADAC that distorts the
# "Other Carved Out" group average. WV remains in all DiD/SC analyses.

other_carveout <- c("NY", "MO", "TN", "WI", "ND")

spread_by_type_clean <- ndc_spread %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("WV", "XX", "PR")) %>%
  mutate(
    state_type = case_when(
      State == "CA" ~ "CA (Carved Out)",
      State %in% other_carveout ~ "Other Carved Out",
      TRUE ~ "Managed Care (Carved In)"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(state_type, qtime) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spread = weighted.mean(spread, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot spread over time by state type
ggplot(spread_by_type_clean, aes(x = qtime, y = mean_spread, color = state_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Reimbursement Spread Above NADAC Over Time (excl. WV)",
       x = "Time", y = "Mean Spread ($ per unit)",
       color = "State Type") +
  theme_minimal()

# Brand vs generic spread over time (also excluding WV for consistency)
brand_spread_time <- ndc_spread %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("WV", "XX", "PR")) %>%
  mutate(
    drug_type = ifelse(classification_for_rate_setting == "G", "Generic", "Brand"),
    state_type = case_when(
      State == "CA" ~ "CA (Carved Out)",
      State %in% other_carveout ~ "Other Carved Out",
      TRUE ~ "Managed Care (Carved In)"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(state_type, drug_type, qtime) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spread = weighted.mean(spread, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(brand_spread_time, aes(x = qtime, y = mean_spread, color = state_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~drug_type, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Reimbursement Spread Above NADAC: Brand vs Generic (excl. WV)",
       x = "Time", y = "Mean Spread ($ per unit)",
       color = "State Type") +
  theme_minimal()

# --- DiD on spread: did CA's spread change post-carve-out? ---
state_spread_panel <- ndc_spread %>%
  group_by(State, qtime) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spread = weighted.mean(spread, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_spread_pct = weighted.mean(spread_pct, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "OH", "NY", "WV", "XX", "PR")) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    periods_to_treat = round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4)
  )

did_spread <- feols(mean_spread ~ treated:post | State + qtime,
                    data = state_spread_panel, vcov = ~State)
summary(did_spread)

es_spread <- feols(mean_spread ~ i(periods_to_treat, treated, ref = -1) | State + qtime,
                   data = state_spread_panel, vcov = ~State)
iplot(es_spread, xlab = "Quarters relative to CA carve-out",
      main = "Event Study: Reimbursement Spread Above NADAC (California)")

# State-level spread summary (post-carve-out only)
state_spread_post <- ndc_spread %>%
  filter(qtime >= 2022.0) %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spread = weighted.mean(spread, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_spread_pct = weighted.mean(spread_pct, units, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_excess = sum(spread * units, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6,  # in millions
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_spread)

cat("\nPost-Carve-Out State Spread Summary (sorted by spread):\n")
print(state_spread_post, n = 55)


```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 11. DRUG CLASS HETEROGENEITY 
# ============================================

process_file_drugs <- function(file) {
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(State != "XX") %>%
    mutate(
      qtime = Year + (Quarter - 1) / 4,
      `Number of Prescriptions` = as.numeric(`Number of Prescriptions`),
      `Total Amount Reimbursed` = as.numeric(`Total Amount Reimbursed`),
      drug_class = case_when(
        grepl("METFORMIN|INSULIN|GLIPIZIDE|GLYBURIDE|JARDIANCE|FARXIGA|OZEMPIC|TRULICITY",
              `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Antidiabetic",
        grepl("LISINOPRIL|AMLODIPINE|LOSARTAN|METOPROLOL|ATENOLOL|HYDROCHLOROT",
              `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Antihypertensive",
        grepl("ATORVAST|SIMVAST|ROSUVAST|LIPITOR|CRESTOR|ZOCOR",
              `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) & 
          !grepl("NYSTATIN|SPRAVATO", `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Statin",
        grepl("SERTRALINE|FLUOXETINE|ESCITALOPRAM|CITALOPRAM|VENLAFAXINE|DULOXETINE|BUPROPION",
              `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Antidepressant",
        grepl("RISPER|QUETIAPINE|OLANZAPINE|ARIPIPR|CLOZAPINE|ZIPRAS",
              `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Antipsychotic",
        grepl("EMTRICITAB|TENOFOVIR|BIKTARVY|DESCOVY|TRUVADA|DOVATO|TRIUMEQ",
              `Product Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "HIV Antiretroviral",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ) 
    ) %>%
    filter(drug_class != "Other") %>%
    group_by(State, qtime, drug_class) %>%
    summarise(
      rx = sum(`Number of Prescriptions`, na.rm = TRUE),
      reimbursed = sum(`Total Amount Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

sdud_files <- paste0("SDUD/StateDrugUtilizationData-", 2015:2025, ".csv")
drugs_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(sdud_files, process_file_drugs))

# Merge enrollment
drugs_panel <- drugs_raw %>%
  left_join(enrollment_q, by = c("State", "qtime")) %>%
  mutate(
    rx_per_enrollee = rx / enrollment,
    cost_per_rx = reimbursed / rx
  ) %>%
  filter(!State %in% c("MO", "TN", "WI", "ND", "OH", "NY", "WV", "XX", "PR"),
         !is.na(rx_per_enrollee), is.finite(cost_per_rx)) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(State == "CA"),
    post = as.integer(qtime >= 2022.0),
    periods_to_treat = round((qtime - 2022.0) * 4)
  )

# DiD by drug class
drug_classes <- unique(drugs_panel$drug_class)
util_results <- list()
cost_results <- list()

for (dc in drug_classes) {
  d <- drugs_panel %>% filter(drug_class == dc)
  
  did_u <- feols(rx_per_enrollee ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = d, vcov = ~State)
  util_results[[dc]] <- data.frame(
    Drug_Class = dc,
    Outcome = "Rx per Enrollee",
    Estimate = round(coef(did_u), 4),
    SE = round(se(did_u), 4),
    P_value = round(pvalue(did_u), 4)
  )
  cat("\n===", dc, "— Rx per Enrollee ===\n")
  print(summary(did_u))
  
  did_c <- feols(cost_per_rx ~ treated:post | State + qtime, data = d, vcov = ~State)
  cost_results[[dc]] <- data.frame(
    Drug_Class = dc,
    Outcome = "Cost per Rx",
    Estimate = round(coef(did_c), 2),
    SE = round(se(did_c), 2),
    P_value = round(pvalue(did_c), 4)
  )
  cat("\n===", dc, "— Cost per Rx ===\n")
  print(summary(did_c))
}

# Combined results table
drug_results <- bind_rows(bind_rows(util_results), bind_rows(cost_results)) %>%
  mutate(
    Sig = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      P_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
print(drug_results, row.names = FALSE)
```
